## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Tests cover the new or fixed behavior (`npm run test:e2e` for UI changes)
- [ ] Any user-facing text is in both languages (`app/i18n/translations.ts`)
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior, setup or architecture changed
